primary_scene_relation_census.interpretation: The earlier historical/reference-scene counts materially underrepresented production use. Both relation code 400 and code 401 carry real non-identity +90 transform state in primary assets, so an identity-only application policy defers authored projection behavior. Edge counts are not yet deduplicated to unique TXMP records in this research checkpoint.

matched_ascii_binary_pair.conclusion: For these two independently matched source-era ASCII/binary texture objects, TXMP +90 begins the serialized SI_Texture2D texture-matrix SRT and its first three floats are rotation XYZ in radians. R=(0,pi,0), S=(1,1,1), T=(0,0,0) reconstructs the exact ASCII diag(-1,1,-1,1) matrix.
matched_ascii_binary_pair.evidence_boundary: Because both matches are pure single-axis Y rotations, they prove the +90 field identity and radians convention but do not by themselves disambiguate general multi-axis Euler multiplication order or direct-versus-inverse projection application.

known_binary_txmp_field_state.offset_plus90: rotation XYZ radians, scale XYZ, translation XYZ is now directly source-paired for the Stasis Truck rlink/rnacelle texture objects; general application/composition convention remains under active validation
